author: jsr
text:
Hi Omid and guys.

Omid, great work and great journal. Thanks for your hard work.

I was studying this trade and realized that your M15 chart was different than mine, hoeschec's and althoufx's.

There is a gap in the data feed in your chart. All 2016-12-26 data and part of 2016-12-27 is missing.

In this case, the PA at the left that we all considered as important was
 engulfed by the same bearish FL, but makes me think that sometimes we
can be unaware of a gap in our charts and be misguided.

I noticed this strange behavior of MT4 a while ago, and for that reason I
 developed the habit of refreshing my charts every time I spend some
time away. Even if it is only a few hours.

I think I'm exaggerating, but as my scripts occasionally do funny things
 because of random gaps in certain TFs, I'm now used to update them very
 frequently.

Sorry for the intromission.
